items.topic: Chapter to revision notes and MCQs prompt
items.hook: Chapter ko revision notes mein badlo
items.caption:
Padha, par yaad nahi? 📚

Is prompt se kisi bhi chapter ke short revision notes, key terms aur 5 MCQs ek saath banao. Answers end mein, taaki pehle khud try karo.

Kaunsa subject sabse tough lagta hai? 👇
sources: original: prompt technique, no factual claims
fact_check: No factual claims. Advice only; no numbers or stats.

slides.title: Chapter ko *revision notes* mein badlo
slides.subtitle: Ek prompt: notes + key terms + MCQs.

slides.title: Padha, par *yaad* nahi?
slides.body: Re-reading a whole chapter before the exam takes a lot of time. Short notes plus a quick self-test are easier to revise again and again.

slides.title: Ye prompt *copy* karo
slides.prompt:
You are my study partner. From the text below:
1. Make short revision notes in bullet points.
2. List the key terms with one-line definitions.
3. Give me 5 MCQs, with answers at the end.

Text: [paste your chapter or notes]
slides.note: Answers end mein maango, taaki pehle khud try karo.

slides.title: Fark dekho
slides.after: Make bullet revision notes from this chapter, list key terms, and give 5 MCQs with answers at the end.
slides.why: Clear format = notes jo revise karne layak hon.

slides.title: AI bhi *galti* kar sakta hai
slides.body: Always check the notes against your textbook. Use AI to revise faster, not to replace your book.

slides.title: Kaam ka laga?

sources: original: prompt technique, no factual claims
fact_check: No factual claims. Example headlines are illustrative; slide reminds to write only true details.

slides.title: LinkedIn headline: *Galat vs Sahi*
slides.subtitle: Profile pe sabse pehle dikhne wali line.

slides.title: Example 1

slides.title: Apni headline *AI se* banwao

Write 5 LinkedIn headlines for me, each under 200 characters.

items.topic: Backward study plan from exam date prompt
items.hook: Exam date se ulta plan banao
items.caption:
Exam date se ulta plan banao 📅

Pehle revision aur mock-test days fix karo, phir baaki topics fill karo. Prompt copy karo aur apni details daalo.

Aapka exam kab hai? 👇
sources: original: prompt technique, no factual claims
fact_check: No factual claims. Planning advice only.

slides.title: Exam date se *ulta* plan banao
slides.subtitle: Backward study plan: ek prompt mein.

slides.title: Deadline se *peeche* chalo
slides.body: Start from your exam date and work backwards. Fix your revision and mock-test days first, then fill in the new topics.

slides.title: Ye prompt *copy* karo
slides.prompt:
Make a backward study plan.
Exam: [exam name] on [date]
Today: [date]
Hours per day: [hours]
Topics left: [list]
Weak topics: [list]

Keep the last week for revision and mock tests. Give a day-by-day table.
slides.note: Weak topics alag se batao, AI unhe pehle rakhega.

slides.title: Fark dekho
slides.after: Make a day-by-day plan from today to my exam on [date], with [3] hours a day, weak topics first, and the last week for revision.
slides.why: Dates + hours + weak topics = realistic plan.

slides.title: Plan *flexible* rakho
slides.body: Missed a day? Paste your plan back and ask AI to adjust the remaining days. Don't restart from zero.

items.caption:
Code mein error? AI se aise pucho 💻

Galat: 'Fix it.'
Sahi: error + code + expected output do, aur pehle cause samjhane ko bolo.

Aur haan: passwords ya API keys kabhi paste mat karo. Aap kaunsi language seekh rahe ho? 👇
sources: original: prompt technique, no factual claims
fact_check: No factual claims. Prompt and safety advice only.

slides.title: Fark dekho
slides.before: My code is not working. Fix it.
slides.after: My Python code gives this error: [paste error]. Here is the code: [paste code]. Explain the cause simply, then show the fix.

slides.title: AI ko *andaaza* na lagane do
slides.body: Without the exact error message and code, the AI has to guess. Paste both, and say what you expected to happen.

slides.title: Ye template *save* karo
slides.prompt:
Language: [Python/Java/C++]
What I expected: [expected output]
What happened: [actual output or error]
Code:
[paste code]

Explain the bug in simple words first. Then give the fixed code with comments.
slides.note: Pehle samjho, phir fix copy karo.

slides.title: Smart *debugging*
bullets: *Passwords / API keys* kabhi paste mat karo
Fix ko khud *run* karke check karo

slides.title: Copy nahi, *samjho*
slides.body: After every bug, ask: why did this fix work? That habit helps in coding interviews too.

items.topic: AI as English speaking practice partner prompt
items.hook: AI ko banao English speaking partner
items.caption:
English bolne ka partner nahi mil raha? 🗣️

AI ko speaking partner banao: ek time pe ek sawaal, aur har reply ke baad gentle correction. Apni repeated mistakes note karo.

Aaj kis topic pe practice karoge? 👇
sources: original: prompt technique, no factual claims
fact_check: No factual claims. 'by voice where the app supports it' is hedged on purpose.

slides.title: Bolne ka *mauka* nahi milta?
slides.body: Speaking improves with practice. If you don't have a partner, an AI chat can be one: by text, or by voice where the app supports it.

slides.title: Ye prompt *copy* karo
slides.prompt:
Be my English speaking partner. Talk to me about [topic] in simple English.
Ask one question at a time.
After each reply, gently correct my mistakes and show a better sentence.
My level: [beginner / intermediate].
slides.note: Level sahi batao, taaki sawaal na zyada easy hon, na zyada tough.

slides.title: Fark dekho
slides.after: Chat with me about [my weekend] in simple English, one question at a time, and correct my mistakes after each reply.

slides.title: Roz *thodi* practice
slides.body: Do a short chat every day. Note your repeated mistakes and practise those sentences out loud.

slides.title: Kaam ka laga?
slides.text: Roz ek naya prompt: study, career, English.
